question: Does a fixed nonlinear carry-aware predictor identify a high-rate quarter on the held-out D341 campaign split?
number: On 120 train and 40 deduplicated held-out samples, preregistered ExtraTrees selected max_depth=6, min_samples_leaf=1, max_features=0.5 by train-only five-fold CV. Held-out r=0.7055091617 and top-quarter ratio=1.3353856275; the joint threshold passed. This remains finite LOCAL_ONLY evidence with safe gain 0 because selection cost, independent generalisation, and solver-success linkage are unproved.
source: our workflow: D431 preregistered ExtraTrees screen
